Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Tarte 3 Chocolats Sans Cuisson Ingrédients Base biscuitée • 150 g de biscuits au cacao  • 60 g de beurre fondu Ganache au chocolat blanc • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 240 g de chocolat blanc Ganache au chocolat au lait • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 188 g de chocolat au lait Ganache au chocolat noir • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 105 g de chocolat noir Préparation Préparez la base biscuitée Réduisez les biscuits en poudre fine. Ajoutez le beurre fondu et mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. Versez le mélange dans un moule à tarte ou un cercle de 20 cm de diamètre. Tassez fermement le fond ainsi que les bords à l'aide du dos d'une cuillère ou d'un verre. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. Préparez la ganache au chocolat blanc Hachez finement le chocolat blanc et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement, puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  mélangez délicatement du centre vers l'extérieur jusqu'à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Versez la ganache sur la base biscuitée froide. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure, jusqu'à ce que la surface soit suffisamment ferme pour accueillir la couche suivante. Préparez la ganache au chocolat au lait Hachez le chocolat au lait et déposez-le dans un saladier. Portez la crème à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat. Laissez reposer 1 minute puis mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et brillante. Versez délicatement cette ganache sur la couche de chocolat blanc bien prise.  Placez à nouveau au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure. Préparez la ganache au chocolat noir Hachez le chocolat noir et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  Versez délicatement sur la couche de chocolat au lait. 🇬🇧 No-Bake Triple Chocolate Tart Ingredients Biscuit Base • 150 g cocoa biscuits • 60 g melted butter White Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 240 g white chocolate Milk Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 188 g milk chocolate Dark Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 105 g dark chocolate Preparation Prepare the Biscuit Base Crush the biscuits into a fine powder. Add the melted butter and mix until you get a texture similar to wet sand. Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm pastry ring. Firmly press it onto the base and up the sides using the back of a spoon or a glass. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Prepare the White Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until the ganache is perfectly smooth. Pour the ganache over the chilled biscuit base. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to support the next layer. Prepare the Milk Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl. Bring the cream to a simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Carefully pour this ganache over the set white chocolate layer. Return to the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare the Dark Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Carefully pour the ganache over the milk chocolate layer.

sugar cookie cinnamon rolls 🎄✨   recipe: tangzhong: ¼ cup milk (60g) 1 tbsp all-purpose flour (8g) whisk together in a small pan over medium-low heat until it thickens into a paste. let cool slightly before adding to the dough. cinnamon roll dough: ¾ cup warm milk (180ml) ¼ cup melted butter (57g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 1 tsp almond extract  1 tsp cake batter extract  tangzhong 3 cups bread flour (360g), plus up to ½ cup (60g) as needed 2 tbsp milk powder (15g) ¾ tsp salt (4g) mix the warm milk, sugar, and yeast together and let sit for about 5 minutes until foamy. add the melted butter, egg, egg yolk, and tangzhong. mix until combined. add the milk powder and salt, then gradually add the flour. start with 3 cups and add more as needed until you have a soft, smooth dough. i ended up using about 3½ cups total. if kneading by hand, try not to add too much extra flour. lightly oil your hands and work surface if needed. place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled, being careful not to overproof. sugar cookie filling: ½ cup salted butter, softened (113g) ¾ cup granulated sugar (150g) 1 egg  1 tsp vanilla extract ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150g) 1 tsp cinnamon  ¼ tsp salt cream together the softened butter and sugar until fluffy. mix in the egg, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. gradually add the flour and and salt until a soft cookie dough forms. assembling the rolls: once the cinnamon roll dough has doubled in size, roll it out into a rectangle, keeping it about ¾ inch thick. spread the sugar cookie dough evenly over the surface. sprinkle Christmas nonpareils over the sugar cookie layer. cut the dough into approximately 12 strips, then roll each strip individually. arrange the rolls in a lined baking dish. cover and let rise again for about 25–35 minutes, until slightly puffier. don’t let them overproof. before baking: heavy cream, for brushing lightly brush the tops of the rolls with heavy cream before baking. bake at 350°F for about 25–30 minutes, or until cooked through. baking time may vary depending on your oven. if they brown too quickly, tent loosely with foil. sugar cookie frosting: ½ cup softened salted butter (113g) 2 oz cream cheese, softened (57g) 2 cups powdered sugar (240g) 1 tsp vanilla bean paste ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1–2 tbsp heavy cream, as needed whip the butter and cream cheese until fluffy. add the powdered sugar, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. mix until smooth and fluffy, adding heavy cream as needed to reach your desired consistency. spread over the slightly warm rolls and finish with extra Christmas sprinkles!     #christmas #sugarcookies Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Chicken Parmesan 🧀🍗 Prep: 10m | Cook: 10m | Serves: 1-2 Ingredients: The Cutlet: 1 large chicken breast (butterflied & pounded even) Rub: 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp black pepper, salt to taste Breading:  1/4 cup flour | 2 beaten eggs | 1 cup Panko + 1 tsp dried parsley Oil for frying Sauce & Cheese: 1.5 cups marinara sauce 1 cup shredded mozzarella Method: 1. Pre-heat Oven to 350F. 2. Prep & Season: Butterfly chicken, pound even, and rub thoroughly with garlic powder, pepper, and salt. 3. Bread: Dredge in flour ➔ submerge in egg ➔ press firmly into parsley-Panko. 4. Fry: Cook in hot oil (or deep fry) for 3–4 mins per side until deep golden (165°F). Move to a wire rack. 5. Melt: Spread marinara on an oven-safe plate, cover with mozzarella, and bake until mozzarella cheese is melted. Broil for last 3-4 minutes until bubbly and browned. 6. Pour-Over: Drop cutlet onto the hot plate and slide the molten cheese and sauce over the top. Serve immediately! #asmr #recipe #cooking #foodtok

Cornflake Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🍗 Prep Time: 30 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Easy Pantry Ranch 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/3 cup buttermilk 1 tsp dried dill 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1 tsp white vinegar or lemon juice 1/4 tsp kosher salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Chicken and Marinade 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, patted dry 1 cup buttermilk 1 tbsp hot sauce 1 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 3-Step Breading Station 3/4 cup all-purpose flour + 1/2 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder 2 large eggs + 1 tbsp water, beaten 4 cups plain cornflakes, crushed into coarse crumbs 4-6 cups neutral frying oil Garlic Hot Honey Glaze 1/2 cup honey 2 tbsp fresh minced garlic 1-2 tbsp hot sauce 1 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tsp apple cider vinegar 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk together mayo, buttermilk, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cover and refrigerate while prepping the chicken. 2. Whisk buttermilk, hot sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Toss chicken tenders in marinade, cover, and chill for 30 minutes to 4 hours. 3. Set up three dishes: seasoned flour, beaten egg wash, and coarsely crushed cornflakes. 4. Drain excess marinade from each tender, dredge in flour, dip in egg wash, and press firmly into cornflakes. Rest on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes. 5. Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F. Fry tenders in batches of 3-4 for 4-6 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 6. Melt butter over low heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute. Stir in honey, hot sauce, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes, simmering gently for 2-3 minutes. 7. Drizzle warm garlic hot honey over crispy tenders and serve immediately with chilled ranch. #cooking #recipe #asmr #foodtok

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! All the credit goes to @Allyssainthekitchen for this AMAZING recipe! 🫶🏼 #ChickenThighRecipe #SundayDinner #EasyDinnerIdeas #ViralRecipes #FamilyDinner

Chicken Aflredo Burritos✨🍗🌯#cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #DinnerIdeas  #foodasmr  Recipe:  For the chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized cubes * Olive oil * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * ½ white or yellow onion, diced * 5 cloves garlic, minced * 1 tbsp flour * 1½–2 cups heavy cream * ½ cup grated Parmesan * 1 handful shredded cheese of choice * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For assembling: * medium flour tortillas * Shredded mozzarella * ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped * Extra Parmesan for garnish Instructions 1. Cut 2–3 chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Drizzle with olive oil and season with onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until well coated. 2. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside in a bowl. 3. In the same pan, melt 2 tbsp butter. Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent. 4. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Sprinkle in 1 tbsp flour and stir until everything is combined and the flour is cooked in. 5. Slowly pour in 1½–2 cups heavy cream. Add the Parmesan, shredded cheese, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and let simmer until the sauce thickens slightly. 6. Pour about ¾ of the creamy sauce over the cooked chicken. Add ¼ cup chopped fresh parsley and mix until everything is evenly coated. 7. Add the chicken mixture to your tortillas, top with shredded mozzarella, and roll them up tightly. 8. Heat a little oil or butter in a skillet and fry the wraps on both sides until golden brown and crispy and the mozzarella is melted. 9. Garnish with fresh parsley and Parmesan. Serve with a side salad or broccoli and use the remaining creamy garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping!

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Day 1 of my Thanksgiving series: The best 5 cheese Mac and Cheese 🧀🦃 The BEST and ONLY mac & cheese recipe you need on your Thanksgiving table! Rich, creamy, extra cheesy, and baked to golden perfection with five different cheeses! Full recipe below ⬇️ Pasta • 2 lb elbow noodles • 2 tbsp chicken bouillon powder Seasonings • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp Nature’s seasoning • 1 tsp blackened seasoning • ½ tsp Cajun seasoning • ½ tsp seasoned salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp smoked paprika • Fresh parsley for garnish Cheese • 8 oz mild cheddar • 8 oz extra sharp white cheddar • 8 oz Colby Jack • 8 oz smoked Gouda • 8 oz mozzarella Cheese Sauce • 3 tbsp unsalted butter • 3 tbsp all-purpose flour • 12 fl oz evaporated milk • 3 cups heavy cream • ½ of all cheeses Instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 2 tbsp of chicken bouillon powder. Add the elbow noodles and cook until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Melt your butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add your seasonings and whisk for 1 minute. Add the flour and continue whisking for another 2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the evaporated milk while continuously whisking to prevent lumps from forming. Whisk until the mixture is smooth and has thickened. Pour in the heavy cream and whisk until everything is completely combined and smooth. 4. Turn off the heat and begin adding half of all your shredded cheeses. Whisk until the cheese is completely melted and the sauce is velvety. Reserve the other half of the cheese for layering and topping. 5. In a large bowl, mix together your cheese sauce and elbow noodles. In a baking dish, layer your Mac and cheese and finish with cheese on top. Sprinkle extra smoked paprika over the top for color. 6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25 minutes. Turn your oven to high broil for 2–4 minutes until the cheese on top is golden and bubbly. Allow your mac and cheese to rest for 10 minutes before scooping and enjoy :) #fyp #macandcheese #thanksgivingdinner #recipesoftiktok #creamy

Viral Chewy Potatoes with Spicy Orange Glaze 🥔🍊 Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 2-3 INGREDIENTS Potato Base 2-3 medium gold potatoes (peeled and roughly chopped) 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp water 3/4 cup tapioca starch 1/2 tsp salt Neutral oil for deep frying Spicy Orange Glaze 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed 1 tsp orange zest 2 tbsp gochujang (Korean chili paste) 1 tbsp honey or brown sugar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp grated fresh ginger 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (optional) 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish Fresh parsley, finely chopped INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place peeled and chopped gold potatoes and water into a blender. Blend on high until completely smooth with zero lumps. 2. Pour the blended potato mixture into a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-to-45-second intervals, stirring in between, for about 4–5 minutes total until it turns into a thick, glossy, sticky paste. 3. Stir salt and tapioca starch directly into the hot potato paste. Knead until a smooth, stretchy dough forms. Transfer the warm dough into a piping bag or a sturdy zip-top bag with a bottom corner snipped off. 4. In a small bowl, whisk together orange juice, orange zest, gochujang, honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Pour into a small saucepan over medium heat and simmer for 3–4 minutes until it reduces into a sticky, bright orange glaze. Turn off the heat and stir in sesame oil. Set aside. 5. Heat 2 inches of neutral oil in a deep pan to 325°F (165°C). Pipe short strands of potato dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen scissors to snip them off. Fry in small batches for 2–3 minutes until puffed, cooked through, and very pale golden. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels for at least 5 minutes. 6. Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Return the par-fried potatoes to the oil in small batches and fry for 1–2 minutes until deeply golden brown and extra crispy on the outside. Drain briefly. 7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately alongside the spicy orange glaze for dipping. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Follow for more #mealprep #roasted #chicken #parmesan #healthyrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. You may need a few extra minutes in the oven! #easyrecipes #quickrecipe #cinnamonrolls #floridablogger #tastewithnicki

We thought we’d try sharing meal prep early for next week so you can plan ahead! Let us know if this timing is better! CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. Roast at 425°F until browned + crisp around the edges. Full recipes on Substack! #m#mealprepm#mealprepideass#sheetpandinnerk#kebabsc#chipotleC@ChipotleS@Sur La Table

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

I present to you: CRACK CORN This is such an easy thanksgiving side recipe, perfect for the holidays, and one of those dishes that will have everyone talking. It’s SO easy to make, and  comes out SO good. Here is how to make it: 1.Preheat oven to 425F. 2.Grab an oven safe dish. Pack it nice and tight with 7-8 ears of corn. You can cut these in half, or keep them whole. 4.In a bowl, mix 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp thyme, 1.5 tsp smoked paprika, a generous pinch of salt and pepper, 4-5 freshly minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp honey. Mix it really well, then brush it over the corn on all sides. 5.Top each of the corn with 1-2 tsp of butter, and sprinkle some finely grated parmesan cheese on top of each 6.Pour one cup of cream around the corn, then cover with parchment paper or tin foil, and pop in the oven for 35 minutes. 7.Remove from the oven, toss the corn around to cover it with all the juices, top with more parmesan, some fresh finely chopped parsley, and a drizzle of honey then pop it back in on broil for 5-6 minutes, but keep a close eye on it as some ovens run hotter. 8.Remove from the oven, spoon over some of the sauce on each, a little fresh parsley, squeeze some lime or lemon juice on top and ENJOY! I just KNOW you’ve got everything you need for the sauce. 🥰 Recipe below! - N x ❤️ Honey Garlic Chicken Breast   INGREDIENTS 500 g / 1 lb chicken breast , boneless and skinless (2 pieces) Salt and pepper 1/4 cup (60g) flour 3.5 tbsp (50g) unsalted butter 2 garlic cloves , minced 1 1/2 tbsp cider vinegar (or white or other clear vinegar) 1 tbsp light soy sauce (or all purpose) 1/3 cup / 90g honey (or maple syrup)   DIRECTIONS 1. Cut the breasts in half horizontally to create 4 steaks in total. Sprinkle each side with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, shaking off excess. 2. Melt most of the butter in a large skillet over high heat - hold back about 1 tsp for later. Cook chicken for 2 - 3 min until golden, turn and cook the other side for 1 min. 3. Turn heat down slightly to medium high. 4. Make a bit of room in the pan and add garlic and top with remaining dab of butter. Stir garlic briefly once butter melts. 5. Add vinegar, soy sauce and honey. Stir / shake pan to combine. Bring sauce to simmer, then simmer for 1 minute or until slightly thickened. 6. Turn chicken to coat in sauce. If the sauce gets too thick, add a touch of water and stir. 7. Remove from stove immediately. Place chicken on plates and drizzle over remaining sauce. #recipetineats #chickenbreastrecipe #honeygarlichicken

AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code → Local → Select folder → AI Editor. Needs a paid Claude plan. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here, Python 3.14 or older: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Check cut points by audio level. Keep pauses that serve the meaning, breaths and word endings. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

BAKED MAC N CHEESE🧀🦃 DAY 1 of my Thanksgiving Side Dish Series! 🦃🧀 Starting off strong with my homemade Baked Mac & Cheese because you simply cannot have Thanksgiving without mac & cheese! Creamy, cheesy, and loaded with FIVE different cheeses. 🤤 Ingredients: 24 oz elbow macaroni 6 tbsp butter 6 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 cups whole milk 3 cups heavy cream 8 oz sharp cheddar, shredded 8 oz Colby Jack, shredded 8 oz medium cheddar, shredded 8 oz mozzarella, shredded 4 oz Gruyère, shredded Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp ground mustard 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp salt (or to taste) Directions: 1. Boil macaroni in salted water for about 6 minutes, just shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. It’ll finish cooking in the oven! 2. In the same pot, melt butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly to remove the raw flour taste without browning. Stir in seasonings. 3. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth, followed by heavy cream. Cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring frequently, until warmed through and slightly thickened. Don’t let it boil! 4. Turn OFF the heat! This is key! Adding cheese over high heat can cause the proteins to tighten and the oils to separate, leaving you with a grainy, greasy sauce instead of a smooth, creamy one. Gradually stir in HALF your shredded cheese until melted and silky. 5. Fold in macaroni until completely coated. In a greased 9x13 baking dish, layer half the macaroni, half the remaining cheese, the rest of the macaroni, and finish with the remaining cheese. 6. Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes until hot and melted. Keep an eye on it! For that golden, crispy cheesy top, broil on high for 2–3 minutes, watching closely. And that’s it! The perfect cheesy, creamy Thanksgiving side dish! 🧀🤎 SAVE this recipe for your Thanksgiving menu! 🦃 #bakedmac #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgiving #sidedish #floridablogger

Crack Chicken Bake 🐔🧀🥓🍲🔥 RECIPE ⬇️ Ingredients: Chicken Breast Cream Cheese Sour Cream Jalapeños  Bacon Colby Jack Cheese Seasonings: Paprika Seasoned Salt Black Pepper Garlic Powder Ranch Seasoning Onion Powder Instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Cut your chicken into bite-sized pieces and add them to a 7x11 baking dish. Season the chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, seasoned salt, and paprika. Mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated. In a separate bowl, add one block of softened cream cheese and season with garlic powder and pepper. Add a spoonful of sour cream, one diced jalapeño, 3 pieces of crumbled bacon, a handful of Colby Jack cheese, and one packet of ranch seasoning. Mix until well combined. Spread the mixture evenly over the chicken. Top with additional cheese and bacon. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and the top is hot and bubbly. Enjoy!🤍👩🏼‍🍳 #fyp #DinnerIdeas #weeknightdinner #cookingtiktok #budgetfriendlymeals @McCormick Spices @Lawry’s Seasoning @Hidden Valley Ranch

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

In an informal discussion, political commentator KingFace defended former President Donald Trump against persistent accusations of racism. Wearing campaign apparel, the speaker argued that federal initiatives enacted during Trump's presidency provided direct, measurable assistance to minority communities. To substantiate his claims, he highlighted federal funding directed toward low-income neighborhoods and renewed financial support for historically Black colleges and universities. He also underscored criminal justice reform, emphasizing that federal legislation led to the release of over four thousand individuals, predominantly Black nonviolent offenders. This dialogue reflects an ongoing debate regarding political alignment among Black Americans. As elections approach, voters and commentators frequently dispute whether traditional Democratic loyalty or conservative economic and judicial policies provide the most effective path forward for community advancement. The defining moment arrived when the commentator declared his unwavering support for Trump and sarcastically rejected critics by embracing policies that deliver tangible results. The exchange leaves viewers evaluating the relationship between legislative records and demographic voting trends. #PoliticalDebate #TrumpSupporters #HBCU #CriminalJusticeReform #BlackVoters
